paragraphs: Playground Guardian sells onsite safety inspection of playground equipment and surfacing, checking that they meet safety standards. The company also sells Park Protector, a playground inspection and asset management application that runs on a computer or mobile device. Playground Guardian is based in Charlotte, North Carolina.

Park Protector records inspections on any device with or without cell service, and is built to CPSC Publication 325 and ASTM standards. The surface testing module captures the data fields required by ASTM F1292 and F3313, including HIC, Gmax, impact velocity, and drop height. Inspections, surface tests, issues, work orders, and complaints export to PDF or Excel.

Park Protector is offered for managing inspections across city-owned play spaces and facilities. The software page names parks, school districts, and municipal facilities across the United States. Park Protector is presented for organizations ranging from solo CPSI inspectors to large municipal departments. Organizations that already have maintenance staff managing their facilities are offered the Park Protector app.

quote.text: Park Protector replaces clipboards, spreadsheets, and disconnected tools with a single app built around how inspection professionals actually work: in the field, across dozens of locations, with or without a signal.
